newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka 1997 GDP growth seen at six percent.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka 1997 GDP growth seen at six percent.

text.p: Sri Lanka's gross domestic product (GDP) growth is seen at six percent this year compared to 3.8 percent in 1996, the Central Bank's deputy governor said on Thursday.
"It should be six percent in 1997 and reach eight percent in 1998," S. Easparathasan told Reuters in an interview.
He said seven to eight percent sustained growth was possible for Sri Lanka in the medium term.
The Central Bank said in its annual report released on Wednesday that GDP growth in 1996 was 3.8 percent, down sharply from 5.5 percent in the previous year.
